cards.name: Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor
cards.text: Light: If you control, Luke and Obi-Wan are power +2 on Death Star. Dark: If you control, opponent needs 2 ability to control each Death Star site.

cards.name: Luke
cards.text: Must deploy on Tatooine, but may move elsewhere. May not be deployed if two or more of opponent's unique (•) characters on table. Your warriors at same site as Luke, or adjacent sites are forfeit +1.

characterConformance.scope: Fixed Tatooine one-turn checkpoints: Luke cost/location/unique-copy restriction, free Rebel Troopers at Luke, same/adjacent warrior forfeit modifier and its removal, Tusken personal and noncumulative total power. Barrier exclusions suspend relevant modifiers. Luke opposing-two-unique restriction, off-board movement and other location text are not exercised; full-card status remains pending.

cards.name: Run Luke, Run!
cards.text: At any time, move Luke as a regular move (using landspeed for free) to a battle just initiated at an adjacent site. Luke is power +2 during that battle, unless Vader is present or adjacent to the battle site. OR You may cancel Vader's Obsession.

cards.name: Death Star: Docking Control Room 327
cards.text: Dark: If you control, may deploy a docking bay directly from your Reserve Deck. Reshuffle deck. Light: If you control, with a Rebel with ability > 2 present, Force drain +2 here.

cards.name: Vader
cards.text: Must deploy on Death Star, but may move elsewhere. May not be deployed if two or more of opponent's unique (•) characters on table. If in a losing battle, draw destiny. If destiny > 4, 'choke' (lose) one Imperial present (your choice).

cards.name: Vader's Obsession
cards.text: During your move phase, if Vader moves to Luke's site from an adjacent site, begin a duel between them. Each adds two destiny to power. Winner retrieves lost Force equal to the difference. Loser loses same amount of Force, plus the character.

cards.name: Old Ben
cards.text: Use 1 Force if any of your characters (except Obi-Wan) was just forfeited from a Tatooine site. Mysterious 'crazy wizard' steps in and revives (returns from Lost Pile) that character back to same site.

cards.name: Rebel Barrier
cards.text: Use 1 Force to prevent any character or starship just deployed by the opponent from battling or moving for the remainder of this turn.

verifiedBehavior: Opponent just-deployed ordinary trooper, exact target and 1 available Force required
Pay 1 Force atomically with persisted pending Interrupt; no restriction until resolution
Used disposition above paid Force; retains ordinary presence outside battle
Cannot initiate battle alone, is excluded from a battle with another participant, cannot move
Restriction persists through recirculation and expires after both players finish
